d: US President Donald Trump has claimed that not a single Iranian ship has managed to breach the American naval blockade in the Strait of Hormuz. Speaking at the White House on November 24, Trump described the operation as the “greatest naval blockade in history” and praised the US military's ability to intercept missiles travelling at speeds of 7,000 miles per hour. He also reiterated Washington's commitment to ensuring Iran never acquires nuclear weapons.
